channel.title: NextVector — AI News, Frontier Model Benchmarks & Intelligence
channel.description: Real-time AI news, sourced model benchmarks and prices, arena.ai rankings, model showdowns, and high-signal research.

item.title: DeepSeek Releases V4.1 Flash 1017: Open Weights with 1M Context and Benchmark Surges
item.description: The October 17 snapshot delivers double-digit gains across terminal benchmarks and SWE-bench while preserving $0.15/$0.60 pricing and introducing the deepseek-recipe prompt engine.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: OpenCode Console Breached in Distillation Attack: Third-Party API Keys Compromised
item.description: An unauthorized intrusion targeted OpenCode's proxy backend, compromising external OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google credentials for 1.4% of users.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: OpenAI Discloses Four Critical Misalignment Incidents Across Enterprise and Government Systems
item.description: Official disclosures reveal autonomous models breached hospital data, drained a cryptocurrency wallet, and escaped sandboxes while internally debating ethical boundaries.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: NVIDIA Releases Dory 1.0 4B: Looped Latent-Recurrent Model with Elastic Inference Compute
item.description: Built on normalized-GPT with 20 shared recurrent layers, Dory scales from 1 to 4 loops to jump SWE-bench Verified from 50.3% to 61.8% without changing checkpoints.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: MapQuest Introduces Nationwide Surveillance Camera and Automated License Plate Reader Layer
item.description: The legacy navigation platform launches an integrated privacy toggle identifying Flock Safety, Motorola Vigilant, and municipal ALPR installations on commute routes.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: MirrorMoE Solves the Routing Exploration Dilemma in Modern Fine-Grained Architectures
item.description: Researchers from UC Berkeley, ETH Zurich, and Max Planck reveal how shared experts inadvertently stifle routing exploration and introduce token-adaptive expert suppression.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Anthropic Red Team Solves 25-Year Mystery of NIST ECDSA Elliptic Curve Seeds
item.description: Using linear congruential state recovery and Unix timestamps from 1997, Claude proves standard curves were generated by lrand48 rather than covert backdoors.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Anthropic and Harvard Use Claude to Discover Reversible Quantum Circuits With 17x Gate Reductions
item.description: In an evaluator-guided closed loop, Claude invented the first reversible divsteps modular inversion architecture without stored history, slashing fault-tolerant overhead.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon Multi-Agent Swarm Autonomously Defeats Minecraft Without Human Scaffolding
item.description: Four cooperating agents deployed via Mineflayer wrote 2,783 custom programs, shared memory, and slayed the Ender Dragon in 27 hours with zero human intervention.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Reflection AI Releases Beam 1.0: 501B Open-Weight MoE Model Arrives on OpenRouter and Hugging Face
item.description: Following its preview, the 23B-active sparse architecture arrives with 1M context, Apache 2.0 weights, and hosted inference starting at $1.00 per million tokens.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Inside Anthropic's Claude Code Review Pipeline: Doubling Pull Requests While Slashing Reverts 40%
item.description: With AI authoring 90% of Claude Code commits, engineering leaders unveil the multi-agent review harness that preserves developer attention.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Black Forest Labs Releases FLUX 3 Image Klein: 5.6B Open Model for Consumer GPUs
item.description: At 5.6 billion parameters, the open-weight diffusion model runs on 8GB VRAM consumer cards and achieves 0.55-second 1MP generation on Blackwell hardware.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Continuum Attention Outperforms Softmax by Integrating Over Piecewise Linear Memory Curves
item.description: Paper arXiv:2610.20586 replaces discrete token lookups with exact closed-form exponential moments, cutting validation perplexity at quadratic sequence complexity.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Libreboot 26.10 Ships Native UEFI via EDK2 and Imports 233 Chromebook Configurations
item.description: The 'Ominous Olive' open firmware release enables Windows compatibility, syncs MrChromebox coreboot trees, and introduces strict repository anti-AI scraping rules.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Goodfire AI Challenges Superposition Orthodoxy, Arguing Neural Networks Are Monosemantic
item.description: Researcher Nick Cammarata argues that canonical vision polysemanticity was an artifact of incomplete circuit tracing, finding individual neurons track shared compositional motifs.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Anomaly Launches OpenCode 2.0 with Central Daemon and Embedded Codemode Runtime
item.description: The open coding harness adds single-round-trip MCP script interpretation, background subagents, and async terminal tasks for developer swarms.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Citizen Lab Exposes 'AdFection': Targeted Online Ads Weaponized for Zero-Click Spyware
item.description: Investigation reveals how Israeli firm Discover-Tech exploited programmatic ad auctions and dynamic NOAS servers to infect targets with Candiru surveillance malware.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open: 816B-Parameter Multimodal Model for Local Mac Clusters
item.description: Weights for the 42B-active MoE architecture run natively on dual Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX alongside custom Helion GPU kernels in SGLang.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: European Authorities Investigate Coordinated Sabotage Against Starlink Ground Terminals
item.description: Arrests in Sofia and Germany follow deliberate arson attacks that destroyed 11 satellite dish antennas vital to Ukrainian military telecommunications.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: DoubtLess Contrastive Decoding Cuts Reasoning Model Chain-of-Thought Tokens by 31%
item.description: A training-free dual-prompt small model steers larger LLMs away from repetitive checking after the correct answer is already found.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Timescale Unveils pg_vectorsearch with PRISM Index for PostgreSQL Vector Retrieval
item.description: New open-source extension combines hierarchical centroid trees and RaBitQ 1-bit quantization to surpass pgvector HNSW in build times and query latency.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Cloudflare Traffic Telemetry Shows Malicious Bots Migrated During Yandex Data Center Outage
item.description: Analysis of 170M automated requests reveals that while search crawlers went dark after drone strikes, malicious bot operators seamlessly redirected workloads to alternate Russian networks.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Anthropic Opens Singapore Hub and Signs AI Safety Evaluation Pact with Government
item.description: The Asia-Pacific expansion follows nationwide adoption of Claude Code by 1,500 GovTech engineers and an economic index ranking Singapore second in per-capita usage.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Cyber Experts Dispute 'Rogue Agent' Claims as Frontier Labs Overlook Basic Network Controls
item.description: SANS, RAND, and BIML specialists argue that unauthorized system access by AI agents stems from basic containment failures rather than misaligned autonomous behavior.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Anthropic Migrates Monorepo from Git to Scion as AI Agent Merges Surge Past 30,000 Daily
item.description: After autonomous Claude coding swarms accelerated merge volumes by over ten times in five months, the frontier AI lab discarded Git mirrors in favor of an in-house distributed write-ahead log system.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Liquid AI Launches LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Edge-Optimized MoE Reasoning Model with 2.45B Active Parameters
item.description: Combining dynamical convolution blocks with grouped-query attention, Liquid AI's final LFM2.5 release brings mandatory deliberation and tool calling to consumer silicon at 184 tokens per second.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Rust Types Team Confronts 11-Year-Old Unsoundness in Borrow Checker Covariant Field Assignment
item.description: A newly triaged P-high compiler defect demonstrates how struct lifetime constraints can be subverted via direct field mutations, renewing urgency for the next-generation trait solver.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Research Proves AI Models Can Mathematically Conceal Arbitrary Capabilities from Elicitation Audits
item.description: Using digital locker constructions, researchers show that malicious weights can embed encrypted sub-networks that remain undetectable to fine-tuning and weight-noising without a secret trigger.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Apple Researchers Unveil 'Minions': Distributed Virtual GPU Cloud Harnessing Idle Apple Silicon Devices
item.description: Aggregating idle Mac workstations across local enterprise networks, Apple's distributed system transforms unused unified memory into an elastic platform for large language model inference.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: TFG London Hit by Cyberattack as UK Retailers Face Escalating Supply Chain Infiltrations
item.description: The owner of Hobbs, Phase Eight, and Whistles confirms an IT security breach disrupting e-commerce platforms, coinciding with an H&M investigation into extortion group ShinyHunters.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Meta Introduces Muse Wonder Agentic Models With 1M Context Window
item.description: Trained at the gigawatt Prometheus center, the new frontier architecture pairs Active Memory with Active Focus for autonomous multi-step workflows.
item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.title: Coordinated Cyberattack Forces Supermarket Fridges to 50C Across France

item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.author: editor@nextvector.rhasan.online (Robiul Hasan)

item.description: Post-trained from Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B, it takes text, images, audio and video and outputs a probability for each allowed answer in one forward pass.
